# Manifest reference

The manifest lists the tools a game exposes to a player's agent. This page is generated from the validator, so it matches the code. The format is described in prose in [Manifest](../MANIFEST.md), and a machine readable [JSON Schema](manifest.schema.json) is generated next to this page.

Check a file with `gwctl validate manifest.yaml`. The validator reports every problem at once.

## Manifest

The top-level document. JSON or YAML. Unknown fields and duplicate keys are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | integer | yes | Format version. Must be `1`. |
| `game` | string | no | A label for the game, shown in logs. |
| `tools` | array of object | yes | The tools the agent may call. At least one. |

## Tool

One capability a player's agent may call.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Tool name, unique in the manifest. Must match the name pattern below. |
| `description` | string | yes | What the tool does, written for the agent. Must not be blank. |
| `tier` | string | yes | Risk class. Decides which policy controls apply. See tiers below. |
| `caps` | object | no | Per-tool limits. |
| `confirm` | boolean | no | When true, every call needs the player's approval first. Not allowed on `read` tools. |
| `backend` | string | no | How the call reaches the game: `http` (default) or `relay`. |
| `http` | object | http backend only | Maps the tool onto a backend REST endpoint. Required for `http` tools, must be absent (or empty) for `relay` tools. |
| `params` | object | no | The tool's arguments, by name. Calls with other arguments are refused. |

## caps

Optional per-tool limits. Zero or absent means not set. Read tools take no daily caps.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `per_day_calls` | integer | no | Most successful calls per player per day. |
| `per_day_amount` | integer | no | Most units per player per day. Needs `amount_param`. |
| `amount_param` | string | with per_day_amount | Name of an integer param whose value is added to the daily amount. |
| `cooldown_seconds` | integer | no | Seconds a player must wait after a successful call. |

## http

Maps a tool onto a REST endpoint.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | string | yes | HTTP method. |
| `url` | string | yes | A path starting with `/`. `{name}` placeholders take their value from the param of the same name. |

## params.<name>

One tool argument. The key in `params` is the argument name.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | yes | Argument type. |
| `enum` | array of string | no | Allowed values. Strings only. Matching is exact. |
| `min` | integer | no | Smallest allowed value. Numbers only. |
| `max` | integer | no | Largest allowed value. Numbers only. |
| `optional` | boolean | no | When true the argument may be left out. |

## Tiers

| Tier | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `read` | State, prices, advice. Rate limit only. Allowed for coach and operator grants. |
| `safe` | Same rules as a human player. Cooldowns and rate limit apply. |
| `medium` | Spends in-game currency. Daily caps apply. |
| `sensitive` | Paid currency, gifts, deletion. Disabled: every call is refused with `tier_disabled`. |

## Backends

| Backend | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `http` | Signed REST call to the studio's backend (levels 0 and 1). The default. |
| `relay` | Call sent over the player's game client WebSocket (see the relay section of the protocol page). Takes no `http` binding. |

## Rules

- Tool names match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}$` (lowercase, digits and underscores, 2 to 64 characters, starting with a letter) and are unique.
- `http.method` is one of `DELETE`, `GET`, `PATCH`, `POST`, `PUT`.
- `http.url` starts with `/`. Every `{name}` placeholder needs a param of that name. Placeholder values that are empty, `.` or `..` are refused at call time.
- Param `type` is one of `boolean`, `integer`, `number`, `string`. `enum` applies to `string` params only. `min` and `max` apply to `integer` and `number` params only, and `min` must not exceed `max`.
- `caps.per_day_amount` needs `caps.amount_param` naming an `integer` param.
- `caps` values must not be negative.
- `read` tools cannot set `confirm` and take no `per_day_amount` or `per_day_calls`.
- `relay` tools take no `http` binding.
- A YAML manifest is read up to 4 MiB. The studio upload endpoint accepts up to 1 MiB.
- At call time a string argument is at most 4096 bytes.

## Example

YAML is the recommended authoring format:

```yaml
version: 1
game: city-demo
tools:
  - name: get_city_state
    description: Overview of the city.
    tier: read
    http: {method: GET, url: /api/v1/city}

  - name: sell_resource
    description: Sell a resource at the current price.
    tier: medium
    caps: {per_day_amount: 300, amount_param: quantity}
    http: {method: POST, url: /api/v1/market/sell}
    params:
      resource: {type: string, enum: [food, water]}
      quantity: {type: integer, min: 1, max: 1000}
```

The same manifest as JSON, which is what the gateway stores and what `PUT /v1/studio/manifest` returns:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "game": "city-demo",
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "get_city_state",
      "description": "Overview of the city.",
      "tier": "read",
      "caps": {},
      "http": {
        "method": "GET",
        "url": "/api/v1/city"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "sell_resource",
      "description": "Sell a resource at the current price.",
      "tier": "medium",
      "caps": {
        "per_day_amount": 300,
        "amount_param": "quantity"
      },
      "http": {
        "method": "POST",
        "url": "/api/v1/market/sell"
      },
      "params": {
        "quantity": {
          "type": "integer",
          "min": 1,
          "max": 1000
        },
        "resource": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "food",
            "water"
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}

```
